title: Money stored as integer minor units
decision: All monetary amounts are stored and transmitted as integers in minor units (cents) together with an ISO 4217 currency code.
rationale: Floats cause rounding errors; integers are exact and easy to sum.
quote: All monetary amounts are stored and transmitted as integers in minor units (cents) with an ISO 4217 currency code.

title: Infrastructure as code with Terraform
decision: All cloud infrastructure is defined in Terraform and changed only through pull requests.
rationale: One reviewed source of truth for infrastructure.
quote: All cloud infrastructure is defined in Terraform and changed only through pull requests.

title: Observability with OpenTelemetry and Grafana
decision: Services emit traces and metrics with OpenTelemetry; dashboards and alerts live in Grafana Cloud.
rationale: Datadog pricing per host was too high for our scale.
quote: Services emit traces and metrics with OpenTelemetry; dashboards and alerts live in Grafana Cloud.

title: Feature flags via LaunchDarkly
decision: Feature flags are managed in LaunchDarkly; no flags hard-coded in config files.
rationale: Gradual rollouts and kill switches without deploys.
quote: Feature flags are managed in LaunchDarkly; no flags hard-coded in config files.

title: Timestamps stored in UTC
decision: All timestamps are stored in UTC (timestamptz) and converted to local time only in the UI.
alternativesRejected: Storing local time with offset columns
rationale: Avoids DST bugs in settlement cut-offs.
quote: All timestamps are stored in UTC (timestamptz) and converted to local time only in the UI.

title: Mobile app built with React Native
decision: The customer mobile app is built with React Native and Expo.
alternativesRejected: Separate native iOS and Android apps
rationale: Shares TypeScript skills and components with the web team.
quote: The customer mobile app is built with React Native and Expo.

title: PII encrypted with AWS KMS
decision: Personally identifiable information is encrypted at the field level with keys in AWS KMS; PII must never be written to logs.
rationale: Audit and key rotation handled by KMS.
quote: Personally identifiable information is encrypted at the field level with keys in AWS KMS; PII must never be written to logs.

title: CI on GitHub Actions
decision: Continuous integration runs on GitHub Actions; Jenkins is being retired.
quote: Continuous integration runs on GitHub Actions; Jenkins is being retired.

title: Backend language: Python with FastAPI
decision: New backend services are written in Python 3.13 with FastAPI.
rationale: Team expertise and shared libraries with the ledger.
quote: New backend services are written in Python 3.13 with FastAPI.

title: Caching with Redis (ElastiCache)
decision: Shared caching uses Redis on ElastiCache with explicit TTLs; balances are never cached.
rationale: Stale balances caused double-spend risk in the incident review.
quote: Shared caching uses Redis on ElastiCache with explicit TTLs; balances are never cached.

title: Two approvals for ledger code changes
decision: Pull requests that touch the ledger package need two approvals, one from the Platform team.
quote: Pull requests that touch the ledger package need two approvals, one from the Platform team.

title: Email via Amazon SES (SendGrid superseded)
decision: Transactional email is sent with Amazon SES. The earlier SendGrid decision is superseded.
quote: Transactional email is sent with Amazon SES. The earlier SendGrid decision is superseded.
